Markdown.description: Configures the Markdown pipeline used to render Markdown to HTML. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:Markdown'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Markdown/.

Extensions.description: The Markdig extensions enabled in the Markdown pipeline, separated by '+', e.g. 'nohtml+advanced'. Supported values include 'advanced', 'pipetables', 'gfm-pipetables', 'hardlinebreak', 'footnotes', 'footers', 'citations', 'attributes', 'gridtables', 'abbreviations', 'emojis', 'definitionlists', 'customcontainers', 'figures', 'mathematics', 'bootstrap', 'medialinks', 'smartypants', 'autoidentifiers', 'tasklists', 'diagrams', 'nofollowlinks', 'noopenerlinks', 'noreferrerlinks', 'nohtml', 'yaml', 'nonascii-noescape', 'autolinks' and 'globalization'.

OrchardCore_Markdown.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Markdown' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Markdown' instead.
